prompt.en: Which chamber of Parliament is elected by the people?
prompt.fr: Quelle chambre du Parlement est élue par la population?

options.en: Neither; the members of both are appointed.
options.fr: Ni l'une ni l'autre; les membres des deux sont nommés.

explanation.en: The House of Commons is the chamber that represents the people, and its members are elected, by tradition about every four years. Senators are appointed, not elected.
explanation.fr: La Chambre des communes est la chambre qui représente la population, et ses membres sont élus, traditionnellement tous les quatre ans environ. Les sénateurs sont nommés et non élus.

source.quote: The House of Commons is the representative chamber, made up of members of Parliament elected by the people, traditionally every four years.

verification.evidence: The House of Commons is the representative chamber, made up of members of Parliament elected by the people, traditionally every four years. Senators are appointed by the Governor General on the advice of the Prime Minister and serve until age 75.
